what: Small clusters of text scattered within a section scramble in proportion to scroll speed: speed/3400 (max .45), approached at .14 and decayed by .9, and every 8 frames a 22-character band sweeps forward, turning the letters inside it into symbols. Once the top of the section touches the top of the screen (until the section center reaches 30% of the screen, scrub 2), each letter falls 40 to 160px down, ±10px sideways, rotating ±20°, over .25 to .7s power2.in and vanishes (each cluster .06 later), and the center sentence is written one character at a time from the front to match (the last four characters written are symbols)

options.scrub: Delay for the fall to follow scroll (sec), default 2
options.glyphs: Characters used when shuffling, default letters, digits, symbols
options.[data-fx-part=final]: (If present) center sentence written one character at a time as it falls
